_meta.source: Static extraction from functions/index.js and functions/interview|mockinterview|notification/*.js in the repository at analysis time. No functions were executed; this is a code inventory, not a runtime trace.
_meta.deployed_codebase_per_firebase_json: Only the 'functions' directory is registered as a Cloud Functions source in firebase.json (functions.source = "functions"). The functions/jadeer-cv directory is a separate, standalone Node/TypeScript project with its own package.json and is NOT referenced anywhere in firebase.json. Whether extractCVKeywords is actually deployed to the live jadeer-b4953 project cannot be confirmed from this repository.

functions.name: sendAdminOtp
functions.notes: Sends OTP email; OTP value and its Firestore write (AdminOTPs/{email}) are performed by the Flutter client, not this function.

functions.name: sendSignupOtp
functions.notes: Same pattern as sendAdminOtp for JobSeeker/Company signup verification.

functions.name: sendCompanyDocumentRequest
functions.notes: Manually triggered by admin to request an employment-verification letter.

functions.name: notifyCompanyStatusChange
functions.notes: Sends Accepted/Rejected email; called manually by the admin UI after it has already written AccountStatus to Firestore.

functions.name: generateJobPost
functions.notes: Generates job description text from title/position/speciality. No Firestore access; returns text directly to caller.

functions.name: enhanceCV
functions.notes: Also synchronously generates and uploads the enhanced-CV PDF via pdfkit after the OpenAI call succeeds.

functions.name: detectMissingSections
functions.notes: Call 1 detects missing CV sections; call 2 (only if a target job is set) suggests 15-20 skills for that job.

functions.name: resetUserPassword
functions.notes: Unlocks the account as part of password reset.

functions.name: deleteUserAccount
writes: Deletes docs in: CVHistory, CVEnhancement, MockInterview(s), Interview(s), ReportGenerator, Reports, WebSchedule(s), Favorites, Applications, AIServiceRequests, Jobs (if Company, plus their Applications/MockInterviews/Interviews/Favourite(s)); deletes Storage folders applications/, cv/, logos/, mock_interviews/, NewCV/, photos/, reports/, temp_cv_extraction/ for the uid; deletes the Firebase Auth user
functions.notes: Full account-erasure cascade. Requester must equal the target uid (context.auth.uid check).

functions.name: extractCVTextEnhancement
external_services: pdf-parse (PDF) / mammoth (DOCX) - local libraries, no network AI call
functions.notes: Also deletes the temp upload from Storage after extraction.

functions.name: generateCVPDF
functions.notes: Manual/standalone PDF (re)generation, using pdfkit; no AI call.

functions.name: autoCloseExpiredJobs
functions.notes: Overlaps with closeExpiredJobsAndNotify below - see discrepancies list.

functions.name: generateInterviewQuestions
functions.notes: Generates the 10 real-job interview questions (5 technical + 5 psychometric) shown/stored on Jobs.Questions by the job-posting client flow.

functions.name: generateMockInterviewQuestions
functions.notes: Generates 10 mock-interview questions (5 domain + 5 psychometric) for a normalized specialty bucket.

functions.name: generateMockInterviewReport
functions.notes: No PDF is generated for mock interviews. HF_TOKEN secret is declared but the Space is called as an anonymous/public Gradio client (Client.connect uses no token in the code read).

functions.name: generateJobInterviewReport
writes: Applications/{id}: Report, CVAnalysisScore, JobRequirementsMatchScore, PsychometricScore, VoiceToneScore, TechnicalEvaluationScore, Score, ScoreBreakdown, Answers, VoiceToneAnalysis, RequirementsChecklist, PsychometricAnalysis, ReportURL, ReportGeneratedAt
functions.notes: Does NOT read CVHistory or extract/attach CV text into the GPT prompt - see discrepancies list re: cvAnalysisScore.

functions.name: deleteOldCVHistory
reads: CVHistory (age-filtered, exact filter field not fully captured)
writes: Deletes old CVHistory docs + their NewCV/old-CV Storage files

functions.name: onJobDeleted
writes: Deletes those Applications docs, their applications/{uid}/{appId}/ audio folder, and their CV file
functions.notes: Cascading cleanup when a company deletes a job posting.

functions.name: deleteCVHistory
writes: Deletes the doc + its NewCV/old-CV Storage files
functions.notes: User-triggered single-record delete.

functions.name: deleteMockInterview
functions.notes: User-triggered single-record delete.

functions.name: deleteOldAnswerRecordings
writes: Deletes .m4a files under applications/{uid}/{appId}/ and mock_interviews/{uid}/{mockId}/; sets AnswersRecordsURL: [] on each doc
functions.notes: This is the ONLY function that deletes interview audio after processing, and it runs 2 days after ReportGeneratedAt, not immediately after the report is generated.

functions.name: deleteOldApplications
writes: Deletes those Application docs + their Storage files

functions.name: synthesizeSpeech
external_services: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech REST API (voice en-US-Neural2-D, speakingRate 0.9)
functions.notes: Used to read interview questions aloud to the candidate during both job and mock interviews.

functions.name: notifyOnJobStatusChange
secrets: OPENAI_API_KEY (declared but unused in this function)
functions.notes: Fires whenever JobStatus changes for any reason.

functions.name: closeExpiredJobsAndNotify
functions.notes: Overlaps with autoCloseExpiredJobs - see discrepancies list.

functions.name: extractCVKeywords
secrets: OPENAI_API_KEY (declared but unused - no OpenAI call in this function)
functions.notes: Pure local frequency-based keyword extraction (stopword-filtered tokens + a hardcoded tech-terms allowlist) - NOT an LLM call. Deployment status uncertain: this codebase (functions/jadeer-cv) is not wired into firebase.json's functions.source, unlike functions/index.js.
